def: to grow, i.e. (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud

occurrences.text: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
